issue.body:
## Outcome

Produce one end-to-end C-SDLC v3 local preparation workflow.

## Primary deliverable

One end-to-end local preparation workflow from issue input to a doctor-validated PVF plan.

## Verification result

One workflow test proves an issue input reaches a doctor-validated PVF plan under typed state for requirements 171 through 173.

## Unit boundary

Issue completion is exactly one local preparation workflow; individual commands are internal steps and cannot close independently.

## Dependencies

- V3-C: #502

## Retained predecessor scope

- #171
- #172
- #173

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Commands consume typed contracts
- [ ] Bind enforces registered topology
- [ ] Cards render from the active registry
- [ ] Requirements 171 through 173 have CLI proof

## Owned paths

- `csdlc-v3/src/commands/local/**`
- `csdlc-v3/tests/local_commands/**`
- `docs/templates/prompts/**`

## PVF lanes

- `cli-contract`
- `bind-topology`
- `card-roundtrip`
- `doctor-findings`

## Stop conditions

- A command bypasses typed state
- Generated cards require hand edits

## Non-goals

- PVF execution
- GitHub writes

## Canonical planning identity

- Planned ID: `V3-D`
- Canonical title: `[v0.92.1][V3-D] C-SDLC v3 local preparation workflow`
